leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a function to validate queen placements on a chessboard.
Implement a recursive backtracking algorithm to explore board configurations.
Apply the algorithm to solve the N-Queens problem for a given board size.
Initialize and manipulate a 2D array to represent the chessboard state.
Render a visual representation of a valid N-Queens solution.
Integrate validation checks within the backtracking process to prune invalid placements.
Configure the solution to return all distinct board configurations for N.
